Name: NoBugBuzz
Author: MilaUwU13
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Stops Bugs and Cave Flies from doing the annoying buzz sound:3

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Just drop the mod folder into the Mods folder (remember that it has to be a folder and not a .zip file!)

[b]Requirements[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14767]Sound Tweaker at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]

Manifest.Name: NoBugBuzz
Manifest.Description: Removes the flying bug buzzing sound
